description: This file defines extension methods for configuring grain call filters in the Orleans distributed application framework. It adds methods to register incoming and outgoing grain call filters to an IClientBuilder, supporting various approaches including direct filter instances, implementation types, and delegate-based filters.

classes.name: ClientBuilderGrainCallFilterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure grain call filters on IClientBuilder instances.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter instance to the builder's filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Adds a specific implementation of IIncomingGrainCallFilter to the builder, registered as a service.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter (delegate version)
methods.description: Adds an incoming grain call filter via a delegate.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter instance to the builder's filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Adds a specific implementation of IOutgoingGrainCallFilter to the builder, registered as a service.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter (delegate version)
methods.description: Adds an outgoing grain call filter via a delegate.
